action.objective: Verify f2f3, the top exact broad-search move, addressing the ...Bg4 pin on f3.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search over all legal moves completed: f2f3 scored best exact (131), marginally ahead of h2h3 (129 exact) and g2g3 (131 upper). Black's last move ...Bg4 pins the f3-pawn, so f3 both challenges the bishop and prevents ...Bg4xf3 ideas while opening the f-file. It is the reserved verification candidate with a 2000-node allowance. No refutation is proven; this call must confirm no immediate mate or checking-reply refutation before commit.
